items.reason: 'Low-dose IL-15 is administered after NK-cell infusion(s) to support NK-cell survival' - a cytokine given to support a cell therapy is part of the excluded therapy under R4; it has no own arm or outcome. Pembrolizumab remains the only candidate.

items.ruling_applied: R4; manual §3.1 rule 4 and worked example (pembrolizumab + vaccine)
items.reason: With IL-15 part of the excluded NK-cell therapy and CY/FLU supportive conditioning (manual rule 2/R6), pembrolizumab is the only investigational pharmacological agent.

items.proposed: excluded_intervention_type (part of the NK-cell therapy; not a candidate)
items.reason: Stated purpose 'to support NK-cell survival'; R4 lists IL-15 explicitly as part of the excluded therapy. Not a candidate under either A's doubt or B's 'supportive'.

The partner of the candidate pembrolizumab is the NK-cell therapy, of which IL-15 is a part (R4); pembrolizumab itself is the candidate and should not be its own partner; CY/FLU lymphodepletion is supportive (R6).

note: Pembrolizumab is optional per title ('± Pembrolizumab') but only one arm is registered and it includes pembrolizumab. R4 says 'part of the excluded therapy'; role excluded_intervention_type is proposed for IL-15 (B coded supportive) - either way not a candidate.
